suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved without a single back-and-forth comment.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes before Fajr when the fan is off and the house finally stops humming.
I'm grateful for a senior dev who actually explained the legacy code instead of just saying don't touch it.
I'm thankful for teh tarik that's still warm by the time I sit down with it, not lukewarm from waiting in line.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally stopped being flaky after I found the real race condition.
I'm thankful for my mum texting a photo of dinner she's keeping for me even though I said I'd eat out.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of a job that still lets me take leave when my grandmother needs a ride to the clinic.
I'm thankful for the LRT actually arriving on time on the one day I overslept.
I'm grateful for a standup that ended in nine minutes because nobody had a fire to report.
I'm thankful for the smell of rain on hot tarmac right before it actually pours.
I'm grateful for a config change that worked on the first try in prod, no rollback needed.
I'm thankful for an old friend from uni messaging out of nowhere just to ask how I'm holding up.
I'm grateful for finding a parking spot right outside the surau with two minutes to spare before Isyak.
I'm thankful for a Friday where the boss cuts the meeting short so everyone can get to prayers on time.
I'm grateful for leftover rendang that tastes even better the next day than it did on raya itself.
